description: Detects the languages on a webpage, both declared in markup (html lang, hreflang links, nested lang attributes, Content-Language meta) and present in the body text (Google CLD3), and reports where the two disagree. Use for i18n audits, hreflang validation, multilingual page checks, or when asked what language a page is in.
